title: Scott Hampton
description: Striking a pleasant smile, Grand Moff Tarkin clearly fancies himself "a good man." "I've been a Peter Cushing fan since those halcyon days of Hammer," offers Scott Hampton. "It was a pleasure painting one of the great faces of film. Hampton began his illustration career in 1983, rendering SILVER-HEELS for Pacific Comics. Marvel's EPIC ILLUSTRATED followed, along uith HELLRAISER and various graphic novels including BOOKS OF MAGIC, BATMAN-NlGHT-CRIES, and one of his finest offerings, PIGEONS FROM HELL.
